— INDEX 005 · OUR ADVANTAGE

## Proprietary technology. Technical hiring expertise.  _Neither alone is good enough._

I.

AI-powered search at scale

Our proprietary AI searches across the open web, public code repositories, professional networks, hiring signals, and our own indexed database. It matches against the real requirements of a role — not just the job title — and it moves fast. We cover ground that would take a traditional team weeks.

II.

A private talent database

Built and refined over time, our database tracks technical experience, seniority, location, skills, market movement, and prior qualification data. We don't start every search from zero. We already know where to look.

III.

A concentrated technical network

A curated network of developers, engineers, and IT professionals across the UK and Spain — people who've shipped meaningful systems, operated real production environments, and worked inside serious technical teams.

IV.

Engineers assessing engineers

This is where we diverge from every other agency. Before a candidate reaches your shortlist, a senior engineer on our team has interviewed them — live, structured, technical. Systems design. Code reasoning. Architecture. Assessed by people who've done the work themselves. You receive the transcript and a scored assessment before you ever speak to them. No surprises in the room.

— INDEX 008 · QUESTIONS

## Straight  _answers._

01What makes you different from a normal recruitment agency?

+

We are AI-native recruiters. Our process is built around proprietary AI, our own technical talent database, and a curated network of top developers and IT professionals across the UK and Spain. Traditional agencies often rely on LinkedIn searches, inbound applicants, and manual outreach. We combine AI search, structured data, network access, and technical recruiting judgment to find candidates who are already qualified.

02What do you mean by "qualified candidates"?

+

A qualified candidate is someone with evidence of being able to do the actual work required. We assess for relevant technical experience, seniority, shipped systems, communication, availability, location, compensation fit, and motivation. For senior or critical roles, we can also add technical interviews run by experienced engineers.

03Why do you focus on the UK and Spain?

+

The UK and Spain are two of our strongest technical markets. We have deep candidate coverage, strong network density, and local recruiting knowledge across both — giving us better access, faster shortlists, and stronger matching for companies hiring in or from those markets.

04What kind of roles do you cover?

+

Engineering, development, and IT roles: backend, frontend, full-stack, platform, DevOps and cloud, data, ML and AI, cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, and staff, principal, and technical leadership roles.

05Do you only use AI?

+

No. AI gives us speed, reach, and structured signal. Human judgment gives us quality control. The best results come from both — proprietary AI to map the market and technical recruiting expertise to decide who is actually worth your time.

06How fast can we see candidates?

+

Most teams receive a first qualified shortlist within 24–48 hours. More senior, niche, or heavily vetted searches can take longer, but the process is designed to move faster than traditional technical recruiting.

07How much does ON3 Works cost?

+

Agentic (AI-led speed): 7% of first-year base salary. Atelier (engineer-vetted): 20%. Both are pure success-fee — you pay only when a candidate is hired. No deposit, no retainer. A UK agency typically charges 15–25%: see [recruitment agency fees UK](https://on3works.com/resources/recruitment-agency-fees-uk). For full details, see our [pricing page](https://on3works.com/pricing).

08What industries do you cover?

+

We specialise in software engineering, with growing strength in cybersecurity and deep tech (HPC, chips, embedded systems). Our clients range from YC-backed startups to enterprise organisations like CGI, across the UK and Spain.
